title: Confirmation with Media Tile
description: An alert dialog with a tile at the start of its DialogHeader that shows the action, and the title and message beside it, with the actions at the end. It sets role="alertdialog" and hideOnInteractOutside={false}, and the Archive DialogDismiss updates the page in its onClick before the dialog closes. Use it for a confirmation of an action that people can revert, where the tile adds context.
